name: Enhance CG (formerly Saudi Ethraa)
note: Gate 2 (category): verified as a Jeddah B2B financial advisory firm (business valuation, M&A buy/sell-side, IPO readiness, corporate governance), licensed by the Saudi Authority of Accredited Valuers. No consumer retail arm; B2B professional services is a hard-fail.

name: SAITCO
note: Gate 2 (category): independent check shows SAITCO is the Saudi Inspection and Testing Company, a B2B product testing/inspection lab (G-Mark certification), not a retailer. The NAICS 54138 (testing labs) happened to be accurate and there is no storefront.

name: Jawlah | جولة
note: Gate 2 (category): verified as the first Arabic VC/entrepreneurship news and content platform (Riyadh, est. 2019). It is media/content, not retail or e-commerce.

name: Mohamed Yousuf Naghi Motors – Official JLR Retailer in KSA
note: Gate 2 (automotive): the account is the official Jaguar Land Rover dealer in KSA, a hard-fail automotive dealership. The stated 'healthcare' keyword reason was wrong, but the OUT verdict is correct on the automotive category.

name: webetr
note: Gate 2 (b2b_services): webetr.com is a Saudi B2B software/web-development agency (its products are Spark Medical, Maham, Mulkhas), not a consumer retailer.

name: 4Sale International Co.
note: Gate 5b (app-rescue): q84sale/4Sale is Kuwait's largest online marketplace, HQ'd in Kuwait, with 2.5M+ confirmed app downloads, which qualifies outright and overrides category. The original 'non-retail NAICS only' call ignored the app-rescue path.

name: MAF HYPERMARKETS QATAR CARREFOUR
note: Gate 1 (geography): Carrefour Qatar is operated by MAF Hypermarkets WLL, a subsidiary of Majid Al Futtaim, whose global HQ is Dubai, UAE. A storefront run by a UAE-HQ'd group fails Gate 1, matching the rulebook's own example.

name: propertyfinder
note: Gate 2 (real estate): propertyfinder.sa is the Saudi portal of Property Finder, a real-estate listings platform (Dubai-HQ'd). Real estate portals are a hard-fail category and the geography also fails.

name: artofheritage
note: Gate 5 (scale)/Gate 7: the Salla store is live with approved-category heritage crafts and real checkout, but the 50+ SKU catalog is genuinely unconfirmable (JS-rendered, sitemap 404, product pages 403), and the entity is a cultural non-profit rather than a scaled retailer, so the default-OUT protocol applies.

name: INTERTEC GROUP W.L.L.
note: Gate 2 (corrected hybrid clause): Intertec is Qatar-HQ'd and, alongside its Xiaomi/Huawei/Honor distribution arm, runs 9 dedicated consumer-electronics retail showrooms (Mi Stores, Huawei Experience Stores, Honor center in major Qatar malls) plus online shops. This is the Lazurde/Al Andalus pattern; the cross-verification applied the old, since-corrected blunt B2B reading.

name: cupiosnacks
note: Gate 5 (scale): the 'building_materials' keyword was wrong (it is a genuine Jeddah snacks/nuts e-commerce, an approved F&B category), but the catalog is only ~20 SKUs (below the ~50 floor) with no app-rescue, so it fails on scale. OUT stands via a corrected gate.

name: Siwar Foods (SF)
note: Gate 4 (digital channel): siwar.com currently shows a 'coming soon' placeholder with no live transactional store, and Siwar is an FMCG frozen-food brand sold mainly through third-party retail shelves and vending (Radwa-like pattern). No live D2C storefront is confirmable.

name: electric-house
note: Gate 2/Gate 3: Electric House is a construction-electrical trade supplier (circuit breakers, cables, switches/fittings) to 'trade and industry'; even its retail-store network sells the same construction-electrical goods, a hard-fail category (electrical fittings for construction) and a narrow low-repeat line.

name: tuhoon
note: Gate 2 (category): Tuhoon is a Saudi mental-wellness/meditation content app plus a corporate EAP platform (customers include Zain, Bupa, Riyad Bank), not product retail. Healthcare/wellness and EAP SaaS are hard-fail categories, and the app-rescue path is for commerce apps, not a wellness-content service.

name: OKHTEIN
note: Gate 1 (geography): Okhtein is an Egyptian luxury handbag brand founded and HQ'd in Cairo (flagship since 2020), outside the KSA/Kuwait/Qatar scope. The stated NAICS-only reason was wrong, but the OUT verdict is correct on geography.

name: Froyo Cafe
note: Gate 2 (F&B, approved) with Gates 4/5 met: the 'no multi-location scale' reason is factually false. Froyo is a Kuwait-HQ'd frozen-yogurt/dessert QSR chain of 7 branches with 400+ staff and its own online-ordering platform (order.froyo.com.kw) plus delivery, a qualifying omnichannel F&B retailer.

name: liujo
note: Gate 1/Gate 6: Liu Jo is an Italian fashion brand (foreign HQ). In KSA it is franchise-operated and folded into the covered local operator, not a standalone Saudi-HQ'd entity, so it is not a separate qualifying account.

name: ABDULLAH BIN TALEB FOR SWIMMING POOLS
note: Gate 2/Gate 3: A. Bin Taleb (since 1983) is a swimming-pool construction, equipment, and maintenance business (civil engineering/contracting). Even with a pool-equipment shop, this is a construction/contracting hard-fail and a narrow low-repeat category.

name: BYD KSA
note: Gate 1 plus Gate 2: byd.sa is operated by Al-Futtaim (Dubai-HQ'd), failing geography, and BYD is an automotive dealership/distributor, an independent hard-fail category.

name: gulfindustrialgroup
note: Gate 2 (manufacturing): Gulf Industrial Group is a diversified B2B industrial manufacturer (packaging, specialty/construction chemicals, B2B food flavors) with no consumer retail arm. Manufacturing/industrial is a hard-fail.

name: Bleems
note: Gate 2 (marketplace) with Gate 5b: confirmed as a flowers/gifts marketplace/aggregator (dedicated vendor-hub app, Bleemer driver app, 90+ third-party vendors). The 50k+ app-download rescue is genuinely unconfirmable through every available tool, so the Held/default-OUT disposition stands.

name: AlBabtain Auto
note: Gate 2 (automotive): albabtainauto.com is an automotive tires/batteries/service business, a hard-fail category.

name: Alraja Furniture  مفروشات الرجاء
note: Gate 4 (digital channel): the OpenCart site gates every product behind 'Request a Quote' (طلب عرض سعر) with no prices and no add-to-cart, serving government/institutional clients. It is a B2B quote-only system, not a real transactional store.

name: Autocapital
note: Gate 2 (automotive): autocapitalkw.com is a Kuwait car dealership/rental/leasing business (buy, sell, lease cars), a hard-fail automotive category.
